goal: Reduce CompilationUnit's output coupling by extracting printing-related responsibilities (Printer, ConfigurablePrinter, PrinterConfiguration) into a new helper class so CompilationUnit no longer directly depends on those types.

ops.details: Move the three printing-related methods (printer(Printer), getPrinter(), getPrinter(PrinterConfiguration)) out of CompilationUnit into a new class com.github.javaparser.ast.CompilationUnitPrinter. The new class will encapsulate direct use of Printer, ConfigurablePrinter and PrinterConfiguration. Replace the moved methods in CompilationUnit with thin delegating methods that forward to an instance of CompilationUnitPrinter (created lazily or injected). This removes direct references to Printer, ConfigurablePrinter and PrinterConfiguration from CompilationUnit's implementation (they remain in the new class).

outputs: javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/ast/CompilationUnit.java (imports updated: remove direct Printer/ConfigurablePrinter/PrinterConfiguration imports, add import for com.github.javaparser.ast.CompilationUnitPrinter)
ops.details: Remove Printer, ConfigurablePrinter and PrinterConfiguration imports from CompilationUnit; add import for the new helper class. Add imports needed by the new class (Printer, ConfigurablePrinter, PrinterConfiguration) there.

outputs: CompilationUnit methods now delegate to CompilationUnitPrinter; internal call sites updated where necessary
ops.details: Update internal calls in CompilationUnit (if any) to call the delegating methods or the new helper as appropriate. External callers of public methods keep the same signatures (delegation preserves API).
